name: uml_review_site_build
description: Build a navigable static UML review website with overview, entity pages, and optional how-it-works guide pages.

inputs.output_dir: Optional output directory. Defaults to Docs/uml/review_site.
inputs.site_title: Optional website title. Defaults to UML Review Explorer.
inputs.include_tests: Whether test files should be included in the scan. Defaults to false.
inputs.neighbor_depth: How far module neighborhoods should be expanded for context. Defaults to 1.
inputs.max_neighbors: Maximum neighbor modules retained per module. Defaults to 10.
inputs.include_guides: Whether how-it-works guide pages should be generated into the review site. Defaults to true.

outputs.site_dir: Directory containing the generated static website.
outputs.index_html: Entry page for the review explorer.
outputs.context_json: Explorer data bundle used by the website.
outputs.tooltips_json: Tooltip payload map used by the website.
